The purpose of amendment 0002 to RFI 36C26226Q0443 is to attach RFI documents not previously included in RFI 36C26226Q0443, posted on 3/3/2026. Please review and complete all applicable sections.  

Sources Sought Synopsis Only

THIS REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI)/SOURCES SOUGHT/RFI IS ISSUED SOLELY FOR INFORMATION AND PLANNING PURPOSES ONLY. THIS IS NOT A SOLICITATION. 

THE SUBMISSION OF PRICING, CAPABILITIES FOR PLANNING PURPOSES, AND OTHER MARKET INFORMATION IS HIGHLY ENCOURAGED AND ALLOWED UNDER THIS RFI IN ACCORDANCE WITH (IAW) FAR 15.201(e).

The purpose of this synopsis is to gain knowledge of potential qualified sources and their size classification (hubzone, 8(a), small, small disadvantage, veteran owned small business (VOSB), service-disabled veteran owned small business (SDVOSB), or large business relative to NAICS 334510 with size standards of 1250 employees.  Note that if VA s pending market research establishes that two or more VOSB or SDVOSB, who are certified in U.S Small Business Administration site https://www.sba.gov can perform the project, VA will set aside the underlying solicitation per 38 U.S.C. Â§8127.Â  

Responses to this synopsis will be used by the Government to make appropriate acquisition decisions.  After review of the responses to this Sources Sought Synopsis, a solicitation announcement may be published on SAM, and/or GSA eBuy.  Responses to this Sources Sought Synopsis are not considered adequate responses to the solicitation announcement.

REQUIREMENTS: This SPS department requests the acquisition of Esophageal ENT instruments for the purpose of being available for clinical use in support of patient care. The Salient Characteristics must include: 



Must have Integrated Light Carrier that is fully incorporated into the textured handle with built-in protection
Esophagoscope must have a barrel and tip that follow ergonomic features of smooth insertion technology that facilitates gentle insertion while maintaining standard technique.
Must provide nearly full lumen view with constant cool illumination.
Will have a Large Fiber Bundle: for Enhanced distal illumination.
Must have Aspiration Channel on the exterior for maximum lumen clearance.
Must have Oval Fiber Optic Light Carrier for more viewing and instrumentation space in the main tube. Must also provide bright illumination.
Must have a Smooth Distal Tip for ease of insertion.
Must provide a 15 mm Proximal End designed for easy attachment of accessories.
Esophagoscopy instruments in the set must be capable of extracting sharp or large objects (e.g., bones, cones, dentures) and manage food impactions.
Esophagoscopes must be able to visualize the  back  of the throat , including the difficult to reach hypopharynx and upper esophageal sphincter
Must be able to obtain deep, accurate biopsies of the esophageal tumors or lesions
Must be made of the highest medical and surgical grade stainless steel materials to ensure durability and corrosion resistance
Will be capable of dilation and treatment of strictures as well as widening of narrowed areas of the esophagus or placing indwelling tubes
Must have a barrel: a hollow metallic tube, typically 33-43cm long with a beveled tip
Must have a multifunctional head 
Must have a functional head attached to the proximal end and features several side ports for connecting ventilation and light
Esophagoscopes must provide High-resolution Imaging, advanced lighting, protective integration, and ergonomic design, ensuring efficient and safe procedures.

Must be reusable and autoclavable making it safe for repeated sterilization and clinical application

All specified measurements in description must be met as each are fundamental requirements

This notice is neither a request for competitive proposal or solicitation of offerors. This notice is to assist the VA in determining sources only and a solicitation is not currently available.  If a solicitation is issued it will be announced at a later date, and all interested parties must respond to that solicitation announcement separately from this response. Responses to this Sources Sought is not a request to be added to a prospective bidders list or to receive a copy of the solicitation.  Information received as a result of this notice will normally be considered solely for the purpose of determining whether to conduct competitive procurement. This notice does not represent a commitment by the Government to pay for costs incurred in the preparation and submission of information or any other costs incurred as a response to this announcement. Inquiries will only be accepted in writing via email to Rochelle.Malveaux@va.gov on or before Friday, March 6th 2026, by 9:00 am PST Local Time.
